sentences.en: Children depend on their parents for food, clothing and shelter.
sentences.zh: 孩子们依靠父母提供食物、衣服和住所。

sentences.en: Goods at the food and clothing stalls were very cheap.
sentences.zh: 食品和衣物摊位上的商品非常便宜。

sentences.en: Parents must provide their children with proper food and clothing.
sentences.zh: 父母必须为孩子提供适当的食物和衣服。

senses.zh: 给……穿衣，为……提供衣服，赋予（某人某品质）（clothe 的现在分词）
